hooks.command: if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain -- Feedback/session-corrections-log.md 2>/dev/null)" ]; then printf '%s' '{"systemMessage": "Feedback/session-corrections-log.md has new, uncommitted entries from this session. Run /retro-feedback to review them and propose promoting recurring ones into Rules/ or Knowledge/."}'; fi

printf '%s' 'CORRECTION LOG REMINDER: if this user message corrects something Claude just did wrong or redirects Claude to a better approach, append an entry to Feedback/session-corrections-log.md in the repo root (what Claude did wrong, what the user said, the right way; numbered, continuing the last entry number) BEFORE continuing, without asking, and say in one line that it was logged. Corrections only, not every change. Never promote an entry into Rules/ or Knowledge/ without the users go-ahead (that is /retro-feedback).'
